R5_first_passage.rule: settings that reach G1, WR1 and S1 in each of 2021, 2022, 2023; among them the best worst-year excess over entering every day with the same exit; if none, the highest worst-year S, then G

R6_one_a_month.rule: as R5; S judged on 8/12 of the months available in each validation year

R7_one_a_month_stop5.rule: as R6, every setting with a 5% stop

R8_peer_fusion_stop5.rule: single setting: R1 with a 5% stop; nothing selected
